newsitem.title: USA: Wolverine files proxy for Frisch's board.
newsitem.headline: Wolverine files proxy for Frisch's board.

text.p: Wolverine Partners said Monday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a formal proxy statement for Frisch's Restaurants Inc naming its four nominees for the board of directors.
In the filing Jerry Ruyan and Barry Nussbaum of Wolverine said they are seeking proxies for its non-management nominees: Nussbaum, Ruyan, Thomas Doan and Arthur Engel.
Doan does not own any stock in Frisch's, while Engel owns 80,000 common shares, the filing said.
The annual meeting of the Cincinnati, Ohio-based company will be held on October 7 at 1000 hrs ET across the river in Covington, Kentucky.
The partnership holds a 6.5 percent stake in Frisch's or 443,600 shares common stock.
